located_observations.observation: One entire forest-green lamp remains visible with wide curved shade, two supports joined to shade and oval base through collars, and warm luminous underside.
Sharp drafted contour joins actual shade edges and the horizontal extension. The wide light footprint and paper plane remain the nonglyph construction.
Two explanation sentences and the invitation are now read on one common left axis. Invitation is larger and moved out of the lower practical group.
Event/date/time/place and admission/no-reservation/URL remain contiguous semantic groups and share a near first baseline.
Lamp and title remain strongest. The invitation is now visible as an intermediate body line; lower practical groups are cleaner.

residuals.limit: The long two-line explanation is still about 11–12 px and relatively compact; it is smaller than the bold lead sentence and event data.
Body copy is not readable at thumbnail320; this view supports composition inspection only.

product_identity.observation: Deep forest-green colour, wide horizontally curved shade, connected twin supports and oval base all remain visible.

function_contact.observation: All date, hours, venue, visit/purchase/no-reservation conditions and URL are present. No invented physical interaction, launch information or technical specification.

material_edges.observation: Precise product texture and connections persist; lower paper line is close to the invitation start but does not visibly obscure its glyphs. Light footprint remains continuous.
